$comment: Figma parity check (Plan 216). `names` maps a Figma component name to the code name when they differ after case and spacing are ignored. `aliases` reads a code option as another option before comparing ({ component, property, from, to, reason }). `allow` lists differences that are intended: { component, rule, property?, reason }. Every entry needs a reason; an entry that matches nothing is reported.

aliases.reason: size=default and size=md use the same tokens in code (the Button story says so); Figma draws md only.

allow.reason: Layout wrapper with no look of its own; in Figma, aspect-lock a frame.
Story-only pattern built on Form, not a component.
Story-only pattern built on Form, not a component.
Behavioural (resize handle); no look at rest.
sm, md and lg all use the same --space-progress-height, so there is nothing to draw.
rectangular has the same radius as default. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).
xl resolves to the same 40px as lg. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).
text/sm is the same box as default/sm; rectangular and xl are not drawn. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).
full-width matches default at the 960px frame (the container never reaches its max width). Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).
centered differs only with no sidebar; full-width is not drawn. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).
grid has the same background and layout as default. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).

disabled and loading are drawn at rest only (state=default): both are disabled in code, so a button ignores hover and press, and each keeps the variant's colours at 60% opacity (Plan 223). Loading is a variant here, not a boolean, so it can dim the whole button like the code; disabled plus loading is not drawn because it looks the same as loading. 120 of 288.
The error border shows only unchecked and never combines with disabled in code.
Hover, error and success are mutually exclusive looks, drawn as one axis; code uses the props error and success and CSS :hover.
Error and success are mutually exclusive looks, drawn as one axis; code uses the props error and success.
Mixes Radix open state with the error look; drawn as one axis.
Code drives open items with value and type, not one boolean.
Radix open state, drawn as a variant.
Radix open state and a data-active attribute, drawn as variants.
image and fallback are child content (AvatarImage, AvatarFallback), not props.
with-ellipsis is an arrangement of children, not a prop.
with-selection is data (selected), drawn as a variant.
empty and with-results are content, not props.
with-many-pages is an arrangement of children, not a prop.
with-selection and with-footer are arrangements of children, not props.

xl and full are not drawn. Every size is a max-width cap in code (w-full max-w-*), so a wider dialog resizes the instance, and full is 95vw by 95vh with no fixed width. Figma keeps sm, md and lg like Sheet, Popover and Hover Card (owner decision 2026-11-10).

Alert Dialog has no variant props in code. Figma keeps one State option (Default) because the Plugin API rejects setProperties on a set with no variant axis. The action button's variant (default, destructive) is chosen through the exposed Button instance.
hover is CSS :hover in code; Figma can only draw it as a variant.
